name: Golf Master
summary: Golf Master allows you to play a full round of golf on a course – either alone or with up to three friends. Before starting, you can select various options, such as skill level (Beginner, Amateur, or Pro) – which affects wind conditions. You can choose whether to compete in a tournament or practice on a single hole. It's also possible to decide how many holes to play – 1–18, 1–9, 10–18, or just one hole. The game presents a top-down view of the course, and by pressing the spacebar, you can view the rest of the layout. You select your club, direction, and shot power – and watch an animation of the swing. When playing with friends, you must wait for each player to finish the hole, rather than alternating after every shot as in real golf.
